scenarios.label: Synthetic replay - current
scenarios.message: All displayed records are fictional and current within this replay frame.

scenarios.label: Stale snapshot
scenarios.message: The synthetic snapshot is usable but its original timestamp is outside the current threshold.

scenarios.label: Very stale snapshot
scenarios.message: Vehicle positions are more than five synthetic minutes old and are not counted as active.

scenarios.label: Feed error
scenarios.message: The fictional upstream response could not be decoded. Counts are unavailable, not zero.

scenarios.label: Offline
scenarios.message: This browser cannot reach the fictional data service. Last-known records remain visibly unavailable.

scenarios.label: No data
scenarios.message: The fictional request succeeded but returned no eligible records. This does not mean zero service.
